label: D2 after a1 rare-transitioned to S2, late in the episode (trials ~93-99), previous trial rewarded
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), almost exclusively when the agent chose a1 and was taken rarely to S2 (99% of mass; a2 or S1 cases are essentially silent). It also has a strong episode-time gate: 99.5% of activations fall in episode trials 90-99, and all fall in the lowest model-value bin (value < 5.22, i.e. the value drop near the end of the episode). Requiring trial >= 93 and a rewarded previous trial (98.5% of mass) brings dev precision from 0.04 (a1->S2 alone) to 0.82, with F1 0.80 and mass recall 0.91. Activations are larger later in the episode: trial >= 95 has precision 0.90 but recall only 0.55, and the missed activations are mostly weak ones in trials 90-92 or after an unrewarded trial. Magnitude is not modulated by the core pattern or the hidden good state beyond these. It never fires at D1/GO, after common transitions, or on a2 choices. All variables are observed at D2; there is no explicit episode clock input, so the late-episode gate is presumably read from internal time and value.

issues: Factual claims check out on dev: D2 holds 100% of activation mass, with 0 activations at D1 and GO. a2 choices hold 0.6% of mass, S1 states 0%, and common transitions 0.6%. ep_trial >= 90 holds 99.5% of mass, and prev_reward==1 holds 98.5%. The magnitude claim reproduces once prev_reward==1 is included: A & ep>=95 & prev_reward==1 gives P 0.897, R 0.553. Without prev_reward, A & ep>=95 gives only P 0.63, so the explanation's description of that cutoff leaves out a condition.
Reported test scores reproduce: P 0.829, R 0.771, F1 0.799, mass recall 0.893.

Misses on dev and test (395 and 446 steps, 8.7% and 10.7% of mass) are mostly weak activations (0.05-0.3 relative) at trials 90-92 or after an unrewarded trial, which matches the explanation. False positives show no clean phase, choice, or good-state class.

Minor, non-systematic refinement: also requiring that the previous trial chose a1 (prev_action != 2, a stay into a1) removes some false positives. Test F1 rises to 0.825 with ep_trial >= 92, or 0.809 with ep_trial >= 93. Adding the good state or start_high does not help (dev F1 0.77 / 0.74).
Small wording overclaim: the label says 'trials ~93-99', but firing actually ramps up from trial ~90 (6% of mass falls in 90-92) and grows stronger later in the episode.
